baseline: Ubuntu 24.04 / GCC: production Autotools build; make check: 17 PASS, 1 SKIP (privilege-dependent), 0 FAIL.

removed_unreachable_diagnostics: "ERROR: Fatal malloc error: poller error buffer!"

availability: Existing production SNMPv3, availability, ICMP and timing contracts are reused. Current host methods and status handling are retained; the older CMake branch OR shortcut is not reintroduced.
retries: SQL counts disconnected attempts including EINTR, permits only three initial in-place EINTR retries, caps its shared retry count at 30, and stops on failed reconnection. db_query returns NULL on failure. Existing production fault tests cover retry/reconnect paths; the older unbounded EINTR and process exit behaviors are not reintroduced.
formatting: Production numeric classification, multipart output, regex, log/config and CLI contracts are reused. SQL, protocol and log literal sequences stay unchanged except removal of four now-unreachable poller allocation error diagnostics.
database_writes: Production persistence/output/reindex contracts and wrapped poll_host tests cover generated writes, batching, completion and output-failure handling. Offline make check does not claim live MariaDB acceptance.
script_protocols: Existing real PHP child fixture tests cover startup argv, handshake, command framing, response limits, restart, slot selection, SIGPIPE and reap behavior. The newer response bounds and credential-safe logging are retained.
shutdown: Production fault/regression tests and linked/PHP runtime suites exercise thread, descriptor, child ownership and reap paths. Existing graceful process cleanup is retained.
intentional_changes: Poller error buffer and counters have automatic storage and a designated context; their allocation failure paths disappear.
Checksum reads copy native-endian words from byte buffers into aligned uint16_t values; its unsigned accumulator avoids signed overflow.
rtrim checks the buffer boundary before decrementing, including empty and completely trimmed strings.
port_scope: Portable C17 changes were adapted to current develop. Already-fixed regex, PHP bounds/retry leaks and protocol paths were left in their current form; old Windows/platform/CMake modules are absent and are not reintroduced. Existing ICMP sequence mutexes are retained; no optional atomics or Annex K dependency added.
coverage_limits: Offline mocks and local child fixtures are evidence for application contracts. Live databases/agents, setuid, BSD, Windows and full deployment behavior require separate runtime verification.
